name: prediksi-presisi
description: PREDIKSI PRESISI — predictive policing & spatial intelligence (monorepo root)

scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn prediksi_presisi_api.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . ../../database/migrations && uv run ruff format --check . ../../database/migrations
scripts.format:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check --fix . ../../database/migrations && uv run ruff format . ../../database/migrations
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:rollback: cd apps/api && uv run alembic downgrade -1
scripts.db:current: cd apps/api && uv run alembic current
scripts.db:history: cd apps/api && uv run alembic history
scripts.db:sql: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head --sql
scripts.seed:master: cd apps/api && uv run python -m prediksi_presisi_api.seeding master
scripts.seed:crime: cd apps/api && uv run python -m prediksi_presisi_api.seeding crime
scripts.seed: cd apps/api && uv run python -m prediksi_presisi_api.seeding all
scripts.seed:analytics: cd apps/api && uv run python -m prediksi_presisi_api.seeding analytics
scripts.seed:regenerate: cd apps/api && uv run python -m prediksi_presisi_api.seeding regenerate
